admin_head: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique
spending_entity: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique
econ_class: Dépenses courantes (salaires, biens et services, transferts) — capital nil
line_name: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique
purpose: `Article 11` of the FY2024 finance law gives the ministry only as a line in the *Répartition Administrative des Crédits*: **« Ministère des Postes »**, LFR 2023 337 232 800 / LFA 2024 194 457 800. The law states no purpose for the line. The *Budget Citoyen 2024* (p.30) supplies the ministry's stated mission verbatim: *« Acteur de la révolution numérique, l'Union des Comores, envisage l'extension de la couverture des services de télécommunications et l'amélioration de la connectivité par les opérateurs : extension des réseaux 4G, mutualisation des infrastructures, migration vers la Fixed-Mobile Convergence (FMC) et la 5G. Cette révolution numérique impactera directement l'administration publique avec la création du portail d'e-gouv « munganyo ». »* — `ODD 9 / Cible 9.c`, indicator *pourcentage des ménages ayant accès à internet à la maison : 43% (MICS 2023)*.
scope_basis: Ministry envelope. FY2024 is the one Comorian country-year in the corpus with **no published classification below the ministry** — the LF2024's `Article 19` annexes (*tableaux des emplois*, detailed *tableau des recettes*) were promised and never annexed, and no service-grain table exists for 2024. The ministry runs posts, télécommunications and the digital economy together, so the envelope demonstrably contains digital spend among other things and the amount is not separable. From FY2025 the state publishes service grain and the records move to service level.
amount_scale: Full francs comoriens (units), space-separated thousands, no scale header. Proved by `Article 11` cross-footing: LFR2023 337 232 800 − LFA2024 194 457 800 = écart 142 775 000 as printed, and 55 896 496 779 for the whole *MINISTERES* block. ⚠ The *Budget Citoyen 2024* prints the same table in **millions KMF** (`194`) — read the header per artefact.
doc_locator: Loi n°23-019/AU portant loi de finances de l'année 2024, adoptée 27-11-2023, `Article 11` *Répartition Administrative des Crédits*, ligne « Ministère des Postes », p. 6 sur 13 ; capital `Article 7`, p. 4
notes: ⚠ The finding of the year: the rectificative multiplied the vote by 3,5 and the money did not arrive.** Parliament voted 194 457 800 in November 2023; the August 2024 rectificative raised it to 682 681 240; the state executed 183 586 075. Against what parliament voted that is 94,41% — a credible budget. Against what the rectificative promised it is 26,89%. **The +488 223 440 was almost entirely a transfer line (prévision 613 000 000, executed 140 000 000) that was never delivered.** Both bases are stored because either alone misleads. · The three-nature outturn is establishable, and the FY2024 sweep's caution is superseded.** That sweep warned that the transferts row's prévision (613 000 000) *« matches neither the LFA nor the LFR ministry total »* and told the extract pass not to compute a rate. It matches neither **because it is one nature of three**: 44 461 240 + 25 220 000 + 613 000 000 = **682 681 240**, the LFR2024 figure to the franc. There is no investment row for this ministry, consistent with `Article 7`'s printed zero. · No capital, at any stage.** LF2024 `Article 7` prints `0` for État and for bailleurs; the LFR2024 revised capital table omits the ministry entirely; and the execution report has no investment row for it. Whatever digital investment happened in Comoros in 2024 happened outside the budget. · ⚠ The law's number and promulgation date, unestablished by the FY2024 sweep, are now established from a second instrument.** The only copy of the law located is the text as adopted in plenary on 27 November 2023, deposited by Comoros in the WTO accession working party's legislative annexes (`WT/ACC/COM/50`), carrying a blank number `LOI N°23-______/AU` on Assembly letterhead. The *recueil des arrêtés 2024* cites it in its own *VU* clauses as **`Décret n°23-134/PR du 15 décembre 2023 portant promulgation de la loi n°23-019/AU du 27 novembre 2023, portant loi de finances 2024`**. Law number and promulgation decree both resolved; the acquisition line closes. · `released` stage: instrument identified, tables unpublished.** The FY2024 *recueil des arrêtés* names `Arrêté n°24-001/MFBSB/CAB du 22 janvier 2024 portant ouverture et répartition des crédits pour le 1er trimestre 2024` and `Arrêté n°24-047/MFBSB/CAB du 01 octobre 2024` for the fourth quarter, and reproduces a second-quarter opening arrêté whose `Article 1` opens credits *« mentionnes dans les tableaux annexes au present Arrete »*. **The annexed tables are not in the compilation.** So Comoros does warrant credits quarterly, by ministerial arrêté, and does not publish the per-service amounts. A dated absence, not a standing chore. · `audited` stage absent and overdue.** Comoros does enact settlement laws — `Loi n°24-017/AU`, promulgated by `Décret n°24-187/PR du 19 décembre 2024`, settles exercice 2023. On that cadence a *loi de règlement 2024* was due around December 2025 and had not appeared as at **2026-08-04**, roughly eight months overdue. The Cour Suprême's *Section des comptes* runs about four years behind (its `ROD execution budget 2022` was posted 2026-03-03), so an FY2024 audit opinion is expected around 2028. · `amount_usd` left blank.** `lookups/fx-imf-annual.csv` carries KMF only as a ball-park derivation from the euro peg, not a named fiscal-year average from IMF IFS or the BCC, and the driver forbids spot-converting a fiscal-year figure. The Comorian franc is pegged at **491,96775 KMF = 1 EUR**; any euro figure derived from these records is a dated conversion.

admin_head: Ministère 31 — Finances et budget, dépenses communes
econ_class: 6153 — Site Web et Consommation Internet (biens et services)
purpose: `Article 1er` of the arrêté, verbatim: *« Il est autorisé le virement de crédit de la nature 6153 (Site Web et Consommation Internet) du service 9998 à l'intérieur du Budget 2024, a la nature 6135 du service 9998 (Frais de Gardiennage), suivant le tableau ci-dessous. »*
scope_basis: The economic nature is named for the activity and nothing else — *Site Web et Consommation Internet*. The whole line is website hosting and internet consumption for the central administration's common expenditure; there is no non-digital component to separate out.
amount_scale: Full francs comoriens (units). The arrêté's own table cross-foots exactly: 15 000 000 + 311 410 000 = 45 000 000 + 281 410 000 = **326 410 000**, the printed TOTAL under both *Nouvelle* and *Précédente*, with 30 000 000 under both *En plus* and *En moins*.
doc_locator: *Recueil des arrêtés ministériels et conjoints, exercice 2024*, arrêté `N°24-0__/MFBSB/CAB` (Moroni, novembre 2024) *portant virement de crédits de la nature 6153 (Site Web et Consommation Internet) du service 9998 … à la nature 6135 du service 9998 (Frais de Gardiennage)*, `Article 1er` table, PDF p. 104
notes: ⚠ no appropriation stage held — baseline is `revised`.** Neither the LF2024 nor the LFR2024 publishes economic-nature detail, so the enacted figure for nature 6153 is not established. 45 000 000 is the line's position in November 2024, after the rectificative and after the fourth-quarter credit opening. · This is the first named digital budget line the Comorian corpus holds outside the digital ministry**, and it was found in an executive instrument rather than a finance law. It adds a fourth IT-specific economic-nature code to the three the FY2026 framing letter annexes (`2432 Matériels informatiques`, `6021 Fournitures de bureau et matériel informatique`, `6122 Entretiens des matériels informatiques…`): **`6153 Site Web et Consommation Internet`**. · What the movement says.** The state took two-thirds of its website-and-internet budget and spent it on security guarding, six weeks before year end. Against a stated *« révolution numérique »* and a named e-government portal, the common-expenditure internet line ended 2024 at 15 000 000 KMF — roughly €30 000 at the peg. · Only one virement touching a digital economic nature appears in the 127-page compilation; the other movements read on furniture, vehicles, housing, guarding and disaster-risk capital. · `amount_usd` left blank** — no named fiscal-year-average KMF rate is held.
